verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. The pamphlet candidate index marks this candidate with an asterisk ('did not file a candidate statement'). The thin profile is a non-filer gap, not missed effort. Pham has 3 bio items and 1 position, the thinnest position coverage. The 'did not respond to Tribune' gap is confirmed, and OPB notes he shared no pamphlet information. Dated 2024 OPB and KATU profiles exist but were not used (2024 was excluded consistently). The website fightwithheartpdx.com is confirmed on the form. Incumbent=false confirmed.
